title: Chapter 375 Restrictions
content:
Chapter 375 Restrictions

Yunding Dojo, Wuji Palace.

Zhong Yu sat cross-legged, and the purple-gold true energy in his body quickly circulated, and the countless small hidden wounds where the true energy passed quickly healed, and became perfect again.

After a long time, a ray of gold sprayed out from his nose for an unknown amount of time, and his whole body exuded a purple light. Zhong Yu's eyes opened and he let out a long sigh of relief.

"Great, the injury has finally recovered!"

It has been 3 months since the withdrawal from Gaotianyuan. In the past three months, Zhong Yu recalled his army. The Kanto War, which had attracted much attention, ended in such an anticlimactic way, which made people lose their minds. eyeballs.

Zhong Yu still attaches great importance to withdrawing from Gao Tianyuan's contract as his own body.

The contract witnessed and jointly supervised by the four parties of heaven, earth, man and god is not strong enough to overthrow these four parties. No one dares to resist, and the consequence is only one word of death.

Zhong Yu was injured, and his own strength could barely recover to the sixth level. He hadn't even reached the seventh level of the world's highest power, not to mention the legendary high heaven and humanity, which is close to gods and demons. The presence.

Obviously in a weak situation, as a powerful emperor, he would not risk his life and lose his life in vain.

What's more, the killing in Gao Tianyuan gained countless luck, which was just used to make up for his own injuries. Maybe he could take this opportunity to break through the long-established sixth level and reach the seventh level.

As long as he can break through to the seventh level, he is only one step away from the eighth level of gods and demons, and can lift his curse.

The dream goal is right in front of you, as long as you work steadily, it seems that it is not difficult to get it, so why take risks.

When people are in a desperate situation, people often choose safe solutions and abandon dangerous methods.

'Now the cultivation base has been fully recovered, and even after this tempering, coupled with the massive luck just obtained, it has improved somewhat, reaching the seventh level. '

'Now he only needs to spend another one or two months to consolidate his cultivation and stabilize the foundation of the seventh level, then he can look forward to the eighth level, and the curse will be lifted soon. '

The brilliance in his eyes flickered, and countless golden lights kept flickering, but the thoughts in Zhong Yu's heart were constantly flying, thinking about what to do next and what to expect in the future.

'Now that I have reached the seventh level of cultivation, with my invincible strength at the same level, the two supreme gods of Japan, Izanagi and Izanami, are no match at all. Then, about the contract...'

Thinking of this, Zhong Yu felt a headache in his heart.

A breakthrough has been made in cultivation, and now some gods in the Japanese world are not regarded by Zhong Yu.

The only thing to worry about is the aloof Heaven and Humanity, the collection of these two world consciousness bodies, are extremely difficult opponents.

Judging from the class power of this world, after such a long period of accumulation and countless samsara evolutions, the Dao of Heaven and the Dao of Humanity are very likely to be powers above the eighth rank.

This kind of cultivation is already very different from the seventh level, and the distinction between the mundane and the sacred is completely separated, and it belongs to two different levels of life.

If all the subjects under his command are attached to him and agree with Zhong Yu's rule from the bottom of their hearts, it will take five or six years to accumulate.

At that time, relying on the accumulated luck and the corruption of this world, it is not impossible to compete with these two for the dominance of this world.

As long as a trace of authority can be obtained, it is not impossible to directly destroy the methods left by the system to destroy heaven and humanity, and some tricks to make them obediently obey orders.

But what Zhong Yu lacks most now is time, and the rate of erosion of the territory occupied by his subordinates is also extremely slow.

After all, it is a high-level world, and the difficulty of corruption is much higher than that of a small world like the Three Kingdoms. Up to now, only two or three counties have been corrupted, not even a small country has been corroded.

According to Zhong Yu's estimate, even after reaching the end, the speed may increase a lot as the corroded area increases and becomes a general trend.

But even in the most optimistic scenario, it would take ten to fifteen years to completely infect the entire Japanese world. How could he spend so much time here.

The life-span curse was tightly reminded on his head, like a timer that kept making sounds, the sound of tick-tock tick-tock kept muffled in his heart.

The life span left to him is only more than 50 years at most, which is not enough to squander at will.

And the threshold from the seventh to the eighth level is like a natural moat, unlike the previous fifth level breaking through the sixth level, and the sixth level breaking through the seventh level, the difficulty is several times, even ten times more difficult than that kind of breakthrough.

"Damn it, do I really want to give up on this world? This is a world with a power level that is very suitable for me. If I can succeed, the luck I will gain will greatly speed up my breakthrough to the eighth level and reduce a lot of resources. The foundation accumulates time."

Cursing secretly, Zhong Yu was extremely unwilling, but after much deliberation, he couldn't think of any way to solve this problem.

'That damned contract, although it allowed me to get out of my body, but the restrictions left behind always blocked my chances to go further in this world, and I felt like I was unable to do anything. '

what to do?

Countless thoughts flashed through Zhong Yu's mind, they were constantly established and overthrown, but they couldn't find a perfect solution.

After thinking for a long time, I could only let out a sigh of relief.

"Forget it, fate."

After thinking about it, Zhong Yu couldn't find a solution, so he could only sigh like this.

"However, although I have given up on this world, before I leave, I have to grab him no matter what."

A cold light flashed in his eyes, and a cold air radiated, and a thought appeared in Zhong Yu's heart.

"Since this world is doomed to give up, then there is no need to worry so much, and let go to break it completely. Before leaving, plunder a large sum of money, and when the time comes, with a flick of the ass, after leaving this world, who can What can I do. After all, the Dao of Heaven and the Dao of Humanity belong to this world, and outside of this world, they are nothing.”

Zhong Yu thought secretly.

Since Tiandao and Humane Dao have paid attention to themselves because of the contract, although due to the concealment of their exercises, they could not find out that they were an outsider, so they did not make any moves to judge.

But after all, every move was put in their eyes, and many things were as secret as before, but it was impossible.

Such a feeling of being under surveillance all the time is really uncomfortable.

If there is no development, then before you leave, let's go crazy, grab a lot of luck points, and then leave.

As for his own safety, Zhong Yu visualized the figure of that world in his mind, which was extremely small in the endless void, but extremely real.
